observations: ARCH_DEFAULTFP: parseCompilerConfig resolves the default model (__stdcall, extrapop 8) and the __thiscall alias clone (architecture.cc:1337-1347)

CTOR_BIND: the named Funcdata constructor binds the default model immediately with pointer identity (Scope::addFunction -> FunctionSymbol::getFunction -> funcp.setScope, funcdata.cc:48-69, fspec.cc:3879-3884)
OVERLAY_LOCK: the external locked-prototype overlay (input/output/model locks) observes the model already bound — never modellocked-without-model
CTOR_UNNAMED: the unnamed ctor path (funcdata.cc:55-56) keeps a null model

PRINTFLAG: setDefaultModel print-flag side effect (architecture.cc:323-330, rework regression 1) — the resolved default is forced not to print, a non-default model keeps the constructor default (true), and re-defaulting flips the previous back to true / the new one to false
PROTOTYPE_TYPES_BIND: the ActionPrototypeTypes tail (coreaction.cc:4615-4619) binds evalfp_current ?: defaultfp to the unlocked unnamed prototype
CALLSPEC_PRE/POST: a fresh FuncCallSpecs is modelless; the ActionDefaultParams else-branch setInternal(evalfp, void) (coreaction.cc:2327-2328, fspec.cc:3891-3898) installs the shared default model

EFFECT: post-binding hasEffect (fspec.cc:4234) answers with the cspec-declared effects: RAX killedbycall, RBX/RSP unaffected, RCX unknown (unlisted), stack:0 return_address (fspec.cc:2689 injection), stack:0x100 unknown

CALLSPEC_REBIND: a bound-then-locked callspec survives a second ActionDefaultParams pass untouched (outer hasModel guard, coreaction.cc:2318, and the !isModelLocked setModel guard, cc:2325 — rework regression 2)

residuals.note: Rugra's Funcdata has no constructor-time Scope, so the setScope model binding is ported onto set_arch (the glb-availability seam); the ScopeLocal attach/identity itself is owned by that TODO

Ghidra wraps unrecognized convention names in UnknownProtoModel (clones default behavior, isUnknown=true); Rugra keeps PLT-locked protos modelless with the 'unknown' name sentinel (warning parity preserved); callspec consumers reach the default effects via ActionDefaultParams instead
the cc:2321-2326 copy-from-callee Funcdata branch of ActionDefaultParams is unreachable in Rugra (no per-callee Funcdata registry)
fc->insertPcode (cc:2329) callfixup injection for calls is not wired in Rugra
setInternal's ProtoStoreInternal swap is modeled only by the void return-type observable; the store system itself is owned by the PROTOSTORE TODO
